landing.title: Welcome to AloMedia
landing.subtitle: Create and manage your video timelines easily
landing.heroTitle: Edit videos with confidence. No overwhelm.
landing.heroDescription: AloMedia is a streamlined video editor designed for creators who want professional results without the steep learning curve.
landing.heroHighlight: No complicated menus. No endless options. Just you and your story.
landing.features: Everything you need, nothing you don't
landing.featuresSubtitle: Powerful features that don't get in your way
landing.featureSharingDesc: Share your videos with clients, friends, or team members with a single link. No complicated permissions or real-time collaboration needed.
landing.featureTranscriptionDesc: Automatically transcribe your video's audio to text with AI. Perfect for captions, subtitles, or repurposing content.
landing.featureCleanAudioDesc: Remove background noise, hums, and imperfections from your audio with one click. Get crystal-clear sound effortlessly.
landing.featureColorFilterDesc: Apply stunning color grades and filters to your footage. From cinematic tones to vintage vibes, transform the mood instantly.
landing.featureTransitionsDesc: Add professional transitions between clips. Simple, elegant, and impactful without complexity.
landing.featureEqualizerDesc: Tune your audio with an easy-to-use equalizer. Adjust frequencies and fine-tune sound to match your video's tone.
landing.featureSpeedDesc: Speed up or slow down your clips with precision. Create dramatic slow-motion or fast-paced energy in seconds.
landing.step1Desc: Drag and drop your videos, images, and audio files into AloMedia.
landing.step2Desc: Arrange clips, trim edges, add text, and apply filters — all in an intuitive timeline.
landing.step3Desc: Export in high quality and share directly with anyone via link.
landing.socialProof1: "Finally, a video editor that doesn't overwhelm you. I made my first video in 10 minutes."
landing.socialProof2: "Sharing with clients is so easy. They love getting a link instead of a huge file."
landing.socialProof3: "The AI transcription alone saves me hours every week."
landing.faq1Q: Do I need video editing experience to use AloMedia?
landing.faq1A: Not at all! AloMedia is designed for everyone — from beginners to professionals. The interface is clean, intuitive, and doesnt't bury you in options.
landing.faq2Q: Can I try AloMedia without creating an account?
landing.faq2A: Yes! You can start editing immediately with our 'Try without registering' option. Create an account later to save and share your projects.
landing.faq3A: Each project gets a unique link you can share with anyone. Recipients can view your video without needing an AloMedia account.
landing.faq4A: AloMedia includes AI-powered transcription (audio to text) and clean audio (noise removal). More AI features are coming soon.
landing.faq5Q: What file formats does AloMedia support?
landing.faq5A: AloMedia supports MP4, WebM, MOV, AVI, MKV for video; MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC for audio; and JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF for images.

help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: Find answers to your questions
help.faq1Q: How do I create a new project?
help.faq1A: Click the "New Project" button in your dashboard or sidebar. You'll be taken to the editor where you can start adding media to your timeline.
help.faq2Q: How do I share a project with my team?
help.faq2A: Open your project in the editor, click the Share button in the toolbar, and enter the email addresses of the people you want to share with.
help.faq3A: AloMedia supports exporting in MP4, WebM, and other popular formats. Choose your preferred format from the export dialog.
help.faq4Q: How do I recover a deleted project?
help.faq4A: Unfortunately, deleted projects cannot be recovered at this time. We recommend exporting important projects regularly.
help.faq5A: Yes! AloMedia supports keyboard shortcuts for common actions like play/pause (Space), undo (Ctrl+Z), redo (Ctrl+Shift+Z), and more.
help.gettingStartedText: New to AloMedia? Start by creating a project from your dashboard, then drag media files onto the timeline to begin editing.
help.needMoreHelpText: If you can't find what you're looking for, feel free to contact our support team.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we protect your data
privacy.collectionText: We collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, and the content you upload. We also collect usage data to improve our service.
privacy.usageText: We use your information to provide and improve our service, communicate with you, and ensure the security of your account.
privacy.sharingText: We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with service providers who help us operate our platform, subject to strict confidentiality agreements.
privacy.securityText: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data, including encryption in transit and at rest.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. Contact us at privacy@alomedia.com to exercise these rights.
privacy.cookiesText: We use cookies to maintain your session and preferences. You can manage cookie settings in your browser.
